analogy.rationale: The annotated targets HPGDS and HRH1 are not classical angiogenesis effectors, and the nine cell lines are largely non-endothelial, so canonical angiogenesis inhibition should yield little transcriptional response; VEGFR inhibitors share the intended pathway but also act weakly in these cells, while histamine receptor classes match the HRH1 off-target annotation.
